title: The Memories of First Love Case
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Ran, Sonoko, Kogoro) omitted by convention; Shin'ichi Kudo is also omitted under this convention (Conan's true identity) even though the 'first love' backstory revolves around him -- that backstory is captured instead as attributes on Asami's node rather than edges to an omitted person. case_type: attempted_murder (Sawai set the fire intending to 'rescue' Asami, not kill her, but the transcript is explicit it nearly did and he is charged accordingly).

persons.name: Manabu Sawai
persons.occupation: 4th-year Literature student, Tohto University; president of the university's Mystery Study Club

attrs.motive_detail: Asami turned him down when he asked her out the month before; he wanted to win her love by playing the hero who saves her from a fire he set himself

persons.name: Asami Uchida
persons.occupation: 1st-year Literature student, Tohto University; recent winner of a 'Newcomer Award' for her novel; titled Miss Tohto

attrs.backstory: confessed her feelings to a soccer-club teammate four years earlier and was turned down; started a rumor that she had been confessed to instead, to save face
attrs.other_note: national tennis champion in her 2nd year of middle school, but abruptly switched to soccer-club manager in her 3rd year for reasons she never explained

persons.name: Tomoko Hayasaka
persons.occupation: 4th-year Literature student, Tohto University; vice president of the Mystery Study Club

attrs.note: held the rental car key that night; briefly separated from the group to sober up near the station, giving him a window Conan has to rule out by timing
owns the motorcycle that was parked in front of the lodge the whole time, ruling it out as the arsonist's transport
held the lodge's key, making him an early suspect on opportunity grounds alone

locations.name: Bungalow (rented lodge for Asami's birthday party)
Karaoke room near the train station

attrs.note: where the group spent the night while the fire was remotely triggered back at the lodge

locations.name: Convenience store next to the karaoke place

attrs.note: has a fax machine customers can use; the owner's testimony about a mis-sent, backwards fax becomes key evidence

attrs.trick: placed on a chair directly in front of the fax machine so an incoming fax's paper feed would brush the candle flames and ignite nearby wrapping paper and curtains
used as a remote ignition trigger -- sending it a fax from kilometers away starts the fire without any device that firefighters could later find as out of place

attrs.note: kept by the convenience store owner; shows the date, time, the lodge's phone number, and Sawai's fingerprints, contradicting his claim he faxed a friend instead

made using the fax machine's copy feature on Professor Takamura's birthday fax, which was lying nearby, to test exactly where the mechanism would ignite; stained with cake cream and later found on Sawai, who couldn't bring himself to throw it away
attrs.significance: two non-matching burned shapes at the scene proved two separate faxes existed, not one, exposing the rehearsal

attrs.trick: dropped into Asami's drink to make her fall asleep before the fire was set

clues.desc: Asami was asleep on the sofa when the group left for karaoke, but was found on the floor, away from the furniture, after the fire -- and the furniture arrangement itself looked subtly different from before, meaning someone returned and moved both her and the room's contents.

The burned fax remnants recovered from the scene form two shapes that don't fit together as one page, proving two separate faxes were involved -- a rehearsal copy made using the machine's copy feature, and the real triggering fax sent later.

When the group rushed back to the burning lodge, one person said 'she was asleep in the living room, it's already burned up' before anyone had confirmed where in the house the fire was -- only the person who set it could have known that.

edges.detail: drops a sedative into her drink to make her fall asleep
positions the lit birthday cake on a chair directly in front of the fax machine
makes a test copy of Professor Takamura's fax to calibrate exactly where and how the mechanism would ignite
moves the sedated Asami onto the floor, away from nearby furniture, so the fire wouldn't actually kill her before he could 'rescue' her
sends a fax to the lodge's fax machine from the convenience store, remotely triggering the rigged ignition, while publicly buying cigarettes to build his alibi

edges.method: remotely ignites a fire in the lodge's living room via the rigged fax-and-cake mechanism while she slept, sedated, on the floor

edges.detail: rushes into the burning lodge to 'save' Asami as planned, hoping to win her affection as her rescuer

edges.motive_type: literary_rivalry (red herring; lost the Newcomer Award to her and held the lodge key)
